citations.text: I. H. Osman and N. Christofides (1994). Capacitated clustering problems by hybrid simulated annealing and tabu search. International Transactions in Operational Research 1(3), 317-336.
J. E. Beasley (1990). OR-Library: distributing test problems by electronic mail. Journal of the Operational Research Society 41(11), 1069-1072.

description: Osman and Christofides's capacitated clustering (capacitated p-median) problems from OR-Library, all held in one file: each problem places customers on the plane with demands, and asks for a number of medians of equal capacity. The result is one document whose nodes are every problem's customers, named by problem and customer, each with its position, demand, problem, and its problem's median count, median capacity and the best solution value the paper reports. The paper's results use Euclidean distances rounded down to whole numbers.
name: OR-Library capacitated p-median problems
